rationale: CRYPTO_REPLACE has no reproducible output: phileas emits different ciphertext on every call, even for the same value in the same document with a pinned key and IV. So the corpus asserts what the strategy promises rather than what it produces.
Detection is still asserted exactly. Only the replacement text is described by property.
consistent-within-document is deliberately not asserted here, because this strategy does not provide it: the same value encrypts differently each time.
